visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman with short brown hair, wearing circular glasses, a pearl necklace, and a beige blazer, sits at a desk. She speaks directly to the camera with high animation. She holds two white cotton swabs in her hands. The background shows an office with white cabinets and a designer bag on a shelf. (2) A digital medical animation illustrates a hair follicle within the skin. Numerous yellow sphere-like particles, representing sebum or bacteria, are clustered around the hair shaft, causing simulated inflammation. (3) The scene cuts back to the woman, who continues her explanation with expressive hand gestures. A red desk surface is visible in front of her. (4) A close-up animation shows a red, inflamed bump on the skin surface. (5) A montage of real-life close-up images shows a person's face suffering from multiple active acne lesions across the cheeks and chin. (6) A series of animations show skin pores being treated, with small red lines targeting debris. (7) The woman appears again, pointing to her own cheek to emphasize the location of common skin issues. (8) Two skincare product containers, a jar and a white bottle, are superimposed at the bottom of the screen alongside checkmarks. (9) The woman concludes her message with a smile and final gestures, leading into a clean white screen with a logo and brand text.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DRX Series Skincare. [Variety]: 為什麼粉刺會在同一個地方反覆發炎. (2) [Subtitle]: 其實他一定不是同一顆粉刺. (3) [Subtitle]: 一個粉刺它發炎 它變痘痘之後. (4) [Subtitle]: 這個粉刺 它發炎了 周周遭就有一些細胞進來. (5) [Subtitle]: 它會把這個粉刺給消滅掉. (6) [Subtitle]: 它為什麼再次發炎呢. (7) [Subtitle]: 其實它又是長了一顆新的粉刺. (8) [Subtitle]: 一個粉刺通常都不會單獨出現. (9) [Subtitle]: 它周遭一定都會有很多粉刺. (10) [Subtitle]: 也就成千上百萬顆的細小粉刺. (11) [Subtitle]: 這顆痘痘好了之後 會有另外的細小粉刺. (12) [Subtitle]: 也有可能會成熟 成熟之後它發炎 它就變成痘痘. (13) [Subtitle]: 那這個時候你該做什麼事情. (14) [Subtitle]: 就是把那些細小粉刺排出來啊. (15) [Subtitle]: 就是擦這些酸類的東西. (16) [Subtitle]: 所以就是 A酸 A醇 A醛. 果酸 水楊酸 杏仁酸. (17) [Subtitle]: 磨砂膏 控油棉片. [Slogan]: (適合長痘痘&粉刺的人使用). (18) [Subtitle]: 然後擦到你今天摸到光滑了. 哎好像都不長了. 你才可以鬆懈. [Slogan]: (莊醫師的話要聽哦).

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Myth Busting -> Technical Explanation -> Solution -> Call to Action.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the biological cause of recurring acne (it's not the same pimple, but new ones forming nearby) and to promote DRX Series Skincare products as the effective solution for managing these skin issues.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The speaker explicitly mentions skincare ingredients and shows branded products (DRX Series) on screen as the recommended solution.
